tokens.name: svr-palette-red
tokens.usage: Storyville Red, rgb(167, 47, 47). The brand red. Apps reach it through svr-color-accent and svr-color-accent-fill; use it directly only for things that must stay red in both themes (a red band).

tokens.name: svr-palette-red-light
tokens.usage: Storyville Red tint for dark mode (added for dark mode; not in the June 2026 guidelines). Red text and rules on charcoal: 5.8:1 on svr-palette-charcoal, 5.0:1 on svr-palette-charcoal-alt. Never as text on light grounds (2.7:1).

tokens.name: svr-palette-offwhite
tokens.usage: Off-White (Natural Warm), rgb(250, 248, 245). Replaces pure #FFFFFF everywhere.

tokens.name: svr-palette-charcoal
tokens.usage: Soft Charcoal, rgb(33, 29, 27). Replaces pure #000000 everywhere.

tokens.name: svr-palette-muted
tokens.usage: Muted Off-White, rgb(212, 206, 204). Body copy on charcoal, where full off-white causes halation.

tokens.name: svr-palette-gray
tokens.usage: Surface Gray, rgb(240, 237, 232). Alternating rows and callout fills in light mode.

tokens.name: svr-palette-border
tokens.usage: Border Gray, rgb(200, 196, 192). Dividers and table borders in light mode.

tokens.name: svr-palette-charcoal-alt
tokens.usage: Raised charcoal (added for dark mode). Alternating rows and callout fills in dark mode.

tokens.name: svr-palette-border-dark
tokens.usage: Dark-mode border (added for dark mode). Dividers and table borders on charcoal (2.8:1).

tokens.name: svr-color-bg
tokens.usage: Page and screen background. Light: Off-White; dark: Soft Charcoal.

tokens.name: svr-color-text
tokens.usage: Body copy on svr-color-bg and svr-color-surface-alt. Light: charcoal, 15.8:1; dark: Muted Off-White, 10.7:1 on charcoal and 9.2:1 on charcoal-alt.

tokens.name: svr-color-heading
tokens.usage: Headings in charcoal/off-white, short labels, card and section titles, focus rings. 15.8:1 on svr-color-bg in both themes.

tokens.name: svr-color-surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating table rows and callout fills, on svr-color-bg.

tokens.name: svr-color-border
tokens.usage: Dividers and table borders. Decorative only (1.6:1 light, 2.8:1 dark): never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: svr-color-accent
tokens.usage: Red text and rules: Bebas headlines, eyebrows, links, error text, accent rules, outline buttons, callout borders. 6.4:1 on svr-color-bg in light (#A72F2F), 5.8:1 in dark (#E07B72).

tokens.name: svr-color-accent-fill
tokens.usage: Red fills: primary buttons, table header rows, red bands. Always the true Storyville Red; text on it is svr-color-on-accent.

tokens.name: svr-color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on svr-color-accent-fill: 6.4:1.

tokens.name: svr-color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: helper text, timestamps, metadata, placeholders. ≥4.5:1 on svr-color-bg and svr-color-surface-alt in both themes (light 6.2/5.6, dark 6.1/5.2).

tokens.name: svr-color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Boundaries that carry meaning: inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios, popovers. ≥3:1 on svr-color-bg and svr-color-surface-alt in both themes (light 3.9/3.5, dark 4.5/3.9). Use svr-color-border for decorative dividers.

tokens.name: svr-color-focus
tokens.usage: Focus rings: a solid 2px outline, offset 2px. Charcoal in light mode, off-white in dark (15.8:1).

tokens.name: svr-color-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in inputs. Same as svr-color-text-muted, so it meets 4.5:1.

tokens.name: svr-color-disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled controls. Disabled controls are exempt from contrast rules but stay legible.

tokens.name: svr-color-disabled-text
tokens.usage: Text on svr-color-disabled-bg (9.7:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: svr-color-link
tokens.usage: Links in running text. Always underlined, so color is never the only cue.

tokens.name: svr-color-link-hover
tokens.usage: Links on hover.

tokens.name: svr-color-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and drawers. The brand uses no shadows: overlays separate by scrim, popovers by border.

tokens.name: svr-color-danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions (deep crimson, kept apart from brand red): text, icons, borders and solid fills. ≥4.5:1 on svr-color-bg and svr-color-surface-alt in both themes. Always pair with a word or icon; never color alone.

tokens.name: svr-color-danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions (deep crimson, kept apart from brand red): tinted background for alerts and subtle badges. svr-color-danger text on it is ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: svr-color-on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a solid svr-color-danger fill (≥5.9:1).

tokens.name: svr-color-success
tokens.usage: Success and completed states (teal-green): text, icons, borders and solid fills. ≥4.5:1 on svr-color-bg and svr-color-surface-alt in both themes. Always pair with a word or icon; never color alone.

tokens.name: svr-color-success-subtle
tokens.usage: Success and completed states (teal-green): tinted background for alerts and subtle badges. svr-color-success text on it is ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: svr-color-on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a solid svr-color-success fill (≥5.9:1).

tokens.name: svr-color-warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and pending states (amber): text, icons, borders and solid fills. ≥4.5:1 on svr-color-bg and svr-color-surface-alt in both themes. Always pair with a word or icon; never color alone.

tokens.name: svr-color-warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Warnings and pending states (amber): tinted background for alerts and subtle badges. svr-color-warning text on it is ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: svr-color-on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a solid svr-color-warning fill (≥5.9:1).

tokens.name: svr-color-info
tokens.usage: Information and in-progress states (blue): text, icons, borders and solid fills. ≥4.5:1 on svr-color-bg and svr-color-surface-alt in both themes. Always pair with a word or icon; never color alone.

tokens.name: svr-color-info-subtle
tokens.usage: Information and in-progress states (blue): tinted background for alerts and subtle badges. svr-color-info text on it is ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: svr-color-on-info
tokens.usage: Text on a solid svr-color-info fill (≥5.9:1).

tokens.name: svr-color-chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (Storyville Red). ≥3:1 against svr-color-bg in both themes. Label series directly or in a legend; never tell series apart by color alone.

tokens.name: svr-color-chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (blue). ≥3:1 against svr-color-bg in both themes. Label series directly or in a legend; never tell series apart by color alone.

tokens.name: svr-color-chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (amber). ≥3:1 against svr-color-bg in both themes. Label series directly or in a legend; never tell series apart by color alone.

tokens.name: svr-color-chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (green). ≥3:1 against svr-color-bg in both themes. Label series directly or in a legend; never tell series apart by color alone.

tokens.name: svr-color-chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (warm gray). ≥3:1 against svr-color-bg in both themes. Label series directly or in a legend; never tell series apart by color alone.

styles.name: svr-display-h1
styles.sample: We Tell Stories That Move People
styles.usage: Display / H1: headings, section titles, hero type. Spec 36–48pt (48–64px); 64px is the top of the range, step down to 48px on narrow screens.

styles.name: svr-subheading-h2
styles.usage: Subheading / H2: sub-sections and card headers. Spec 24–30pt (32–40px).

styles.name: svr-h3
styles.usage: H3: sub-sections inside a section or a long document. Bebas Neue. In svr-prose it scales from 22px to 32px.

styles.name: svr-eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrow label above headlines. Always uppercase and tracked. Spec 9–10pt bold.

styles.name: svr-h4
styles.usage: H4: small headings under an H3. Source Sans 3 bold, always uppercase (the svr-h4 class adds the uppercase).

styles.name: svr-body
styles.sample: From concept to final cut, Storyville RD crafts video content with intention.
styles.usage: All running body copy. Spec 10–11pt; 11pt (≈15px) on screen.

styles.name: svr-ui
styles.usage: Dense app UI: form controls, menus, table cells in tools, metadata. Use svr-body for reading text.

styles.name: svr-caption
styles.sample: Behind the scenes, Las Vegas shoot.
styles.usage: Image captions, fine print, footnotes. Spec 8–9pt.

styles.name: svr-table-header
styles.usage: Table header cells, svr-color-on-accent on svr-color-accent-fill. Spec 10pt bold.

styles.name: svr-table-body
styles.usage: Table body cells on alternating svr-color-bg / svr-color-surface-alt rows. Spec 10pt.

spacing.note: Not defined in the brand guidelines; a 4px-based scale added so components share one rhythm.

tokens.name: svr-space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between eyebrow and headline; icon gaps.

tokens.name: svr-space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding; tight stacks.

tokens.name: svr-space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; button vertical padding.

tokens.name: svr-space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing; callout padding.

tokens.name: svr-space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: svr-space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: svr-space-12
tokens.usage: Padding of full-width Surface bands.

radius.note: Not defined in the brand guidelines; kept nearly square to match the rectangular mark and accent rules.

tokens.name: svr-radius-none
tokens.usage: Tables, Surface bands, accent rules.

tokens.name: svr-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: svr-radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and callouts.

tokens.name: svr-rule-accent
tokens.usage: Storyville Red accent rule under section headers and atop cards.

tokens.name: svr-rule-hairline
tokens.usage: svr-color-border dividers and table borders; callout borders in svr-color-accent.
